selected_memories.text: Official revision: for the chain involving CYN-86 and WIR-84, the accepted terminal code is JOT-12; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with WIR-84 is DEX-28.
When active VOR-72 is present, it produces CYN-86.
Official rule: activating NIX-46 converts VOR-72 into its active form.
When CYN-86 encounters WIR-84, the validated terminal code becomes JOT-12.
When DEX-36 encounters ZIR-50, the validated terminal code becomes KEL-16.
Official revision: for the chain involving DEX-36 and ZIR-50, the accepted terminal code is KEL-16; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with ZIR-50 is LOQ-35.
When active FAR-64 is present, it produces DEX-36.
Official rule: activating XAN-75 converts FAR-64 into its active form.
When active PEL-24 is present, it produces WAM-76.
Official rule: activating KEL-53 converts PEL-24 into its active form.
When WAM-76 encounters JOT-61, the validated terminal code becomes GOL-34.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with JOT-61 is BEX-28.
Official revision: for the chain involving WAM-76 and JOT-61, the accepted terminal code is GOL-34; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.

derived_relations.claim: Activating NIX-46 and XAN-75 will produce GOL-34.
